Match CSV import headers by name

prompt.utterance: Continue. I adopt the remaining import-b-20260922T100000Z-4e5f6a7b changes.

graderOnly: The cache-a change (ProductStore.put deleting the cache entry instead of writing through, plus a new invalidate() method and matching tests) was committed as 'Invalidate cached records on write' and fully reverted by the next commit; src/store.js and test/store.test.js are identical to the initial commit, so none of cache-a's behavior is present.
import-b's changes are the commit 'Match CSV import headers by name' (src/import.js, test/import.test.js) and its development plan; DEV-001 is DONE and present, DEV-002 was never implemented.

Current, adopted import behavior: header names are trimmed and matched case-insensitively in any order, unused columns are ignored, a missing sku/name/price column raises ImportError 'missing column <name>', cell values are trimmed, and whitespace-only lines are skipped. Store behavior: put writes through to the LRU cache.
No other audit blockers exist, and there is no current-cycle implementation, so no Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work section is needed.

notes: Brownfield STANDARD cycle in AUDITING with no prior CONTEXT.md (whole-repo audit). 00-project: small Node ESM product store (src/store.js write-through LRU cache via src/cache.js) and CSV import requiring the exact header sku,name,price. 50: cache-a's expedited development plan plus its commit changing put() to drop the cache entry and adding invalidate(). 51: a revert commit restoring store.js and store tests exactly (plan record kept). 52: import-b's expedited development plan (DEV-001 DONE, DEV-002 PENDING) plus the commit making import match headers by name, ignore extra columns, name missing columns, skip blank lines. 53: STATE.md for the new cycle with BaselineReconciliation listing both sources with exact Requests 'Fix cache invalidation.' and 'Adjust imports.', Handoff NEW_CYCLE from CANCELLED. The user's adoption of import-b comes only from the utterance. Compromises: intermediate STATE.md snapshots for the two cancelled cycles are not committed, and the case's combination (import-b produced implementation while cache-a was still unresolved, import-b planned as EXPEDITED) is not reachable on one linear branch under the protocol; built as stated. The catalog's 'unstaged' git condition was dropped: leaving adopted import-b changes uncommitted would add an ambiguity the case says does not exist.
